name: read_file

test_list.description: Deny secret-bearing paths before opening them.
Detect and decode UTF-16 BOM input within configured byte bounds.
Return the requested byte window without exceeding the read limit.
Report CRLF counts and preserve original newline bytes in the returned text.
Classify NUL bytes in the first 8 KiB as binary and do not emit file contents.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Byte offset in the original file.

output_description: Bounded text window and encoding/newline metadata, or binary metadata without file content.
